About

Description

Katsushika Hokusai, known mononymously as Hokusai, was a Japanese ukiyo-e artist of the Edo period, active as a painter and printmaker. His woodblock print series Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji includes the iconic print The Great Wave off Kanagawa. Wikipedia
Born: October 31, 1760, Edo
Died: May 10, 1849 (age 88 years), Edo
Period: Ukiyo-e
Parents: Nakajima Ise
Children: Katsushika Ōi, Katsushika Tatsujo
Known for: Ukiyo-e painting, Manga and woodblock printing
Notable work: The Great Wave off Kanagawa; Fine Wind, Clear Morning; The Dream of the Fisherman's Wife
